# GradeForAI

> The industry's first standardized scoring system for AI Agent Optimization (AAO). We measure how ready any business is for AI agents that navigate, extract data from, and transact with websites on behalf of consumers.

GradeForAI scores businesses on a 0-to-100 scale across 4 dimensions of AI agent readiness (the AI Agent Preference Score). Hundreds of thousands of service businesses have been scored across 40+ verticals and 200+ cities. The average score is 34 out of 100, and 89% of businesses fall below Agent Ready. Every score is generated by automated analysis of real business websites. No surveys. No self-reporting. Just ground truth.

GradeForAI is the definitive benchmark for AI Agent Optimization. We help businesses understand where they stand and what to fix so AI agents can actually operate on their website.

---

## What is AI Agent Optimization (AAO)?

AI Agent Optimization (AAO) is the practice of making a business fully operable by autonomous AI agents. It measures whether AI agents can navigate your site, extract accurate operational data, and complete transactions on your behalf.

AAO is the next evolution beyond SEO and AEO:

- **SEO** (Search Engine Optimization) helps search engines find and rank your website. Goal: get discovered.
- **AEO** (Answer Engine Optimization) helps AI chatbots cite your business in answers. Goal: get mentioned.
- **AAO** (AI Agent Optimization) ensures AI agents can actually operate on your website: navigate it, extract structured data, and complete transactions without human intervention. Goal: get transacted with.

SEO and AEO are about visibility. AAO is about operability. A business with perfect SEO and AEO but zero AAO is visible but inoperable. AI agents can find it and mention it, but they cannot book it, pay it, or complete a transaction with it.

---

## The 4 Dimensions of the AI Agent Preference Score

GradeForAI measures AI agent readiness across four dimensions. Each represents a specific capability that AI agents need to operate on your website. Together, they form the AI Agent Preference Score, a composite rating from 0 to 100.

### 1. Agent Accessibility

Can AI agents physically navigate your website? This covers semantic HTML, graduated CAPTCHA handling, form accessibility, keyboard navigation, and how your site handles automated visitors. If agents cannot get through the front door, nothing else matters.

### 2. Transaction Completeness

Can AI agents complete the core transaction your business depends on? Vertically adapted: booking for trades, consultation scheduling for legal, patient portal access for medical, reservations for restaurants, and more. This dimension also measures adoption of agent commerce protocols (UCP, ACP, agent.json, llms.txt) and booking platform integrations. Fewer than 3% of the service businesses scanned have an agent-accessible transaction path.

### 3. Data Reliability

Will the data agents extract from your site lead to successful transactions? This dimension combines operational data structure (schema.org markup, server-side rendering, structured service descriptions, hours, pricing, service area) with data accuracy and currency (NAP consistency, hours accuracy, SSL status, identity consistency). Agents need both machine-readable AND trustworthy data.

### 4. Competitive Position

How does your AI agent readiness compare to competitors in your market? An AI agent choosing between providers will favor the one that is easier to work with. This dimension measures how your readiness stacks up against other businesses in your vertical and geographic area, at both the city level and the greater metro area level.

---

## Capability Bands

Scores map to capability bands that describe what AI agents can actually do with your business:

- **Agent Preferred (90-100):** Booking platform fully integrated with agent ecosystems. Agents will transact here by default.
- **Agent Optimized (70-89):** Strong across all four dimensions. Minor gaps in booking integration or advanced data structure.
- **Agent Ready (50-69):** Agents can navigate and extract data. Transaction path works but has friction.
- **Agent Functional (30-49):** Basic access works. Significant gaps in transaction completeness or data reliability.
- **Agent Detected (10-29):** Agents can find you but cannot transact. Most service businesses currently sit here.
- **Agent Incompatible (0-9):** No meaningful agent preference signals. Functionally invisible to agents acting for consumers.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What is an AI Agent Preference Score?

Your AI Agent Preference Score measures how well AI agents can operate on your business website across 4 dimensions: Agent Accessibility, Transaction Completeness, Data Reliability, and Competitive Position. Think of it like an SEO score, but for AI agents instead of search engines.

### Why should I care about this right now?

Right now, people are telling AI to "book me a plumber" or "schedule a dentist near me." Online stores already work with AI by default. Service businesses have not caught up. If AI cannot navigate your site, extract your data, or complete a transaction, it sends the customer to a competitor it can work with.

### Is this the same as AEO or AI search optimization?

No. AEO is about getting mentioned when someone asks AI a question. GradeForAI measures whether AI can actually operate on your website. Can it navigate your booking flow? Extract your service data? Complete a transaction? AEO gets you mentioned. GradeForAI gets you booked, quoted, and paid.

### What is included in the free scan vs the full report?

The free scan gives you your overall score, capability band, top issues, and how you rank against competitors in your city and metro area. The full report breaks down all four dimensions with individual scores, shows you exactly what AI agents can and cannot do with your business, compares you head-to-head against competitors, benchmarks you against your industry, and gives you a prioritized implementation roadmap.

### How long does a scan take?

Under 60 seconds. Enter your website URL, and we analyze your entire web presence across all 6 AAO dimensions in real time.

### What if I just want to do it myself?

The $199 report includes a step-by-step roadmap you can follow yourself or hand to your web developer. Every recommendation includes a difficulty level and time estimate, so you can prioritize what to tackle first.

### Can you fix my score for me?

Yes. We offer done-for-you packages starting at $2,500 where we handle everything: making your business operable by AI agents, setting up transaction paths, connecting payment systems, and implementing every fix in the report. We include a post-implementation rescan so you can see the improvement in your AAO score.

### Do you guarantee results?

Yes. Reports come with a 7-day money-back guarantee. If you purchase the done-for-you implementation, we include a post-fix rescan so you can see the improvement before the project closes.

### What verticals do you cover?

All service businesses. We have benchmarks for 40+ verticals, including dental, HVAC, legal, real estate, med spas, salons, and many more. Your report includes comparisons against businesses in your specific industry and local market.

### Still have questions?

Reach out any time at hello@gradeforai.com. We typically respond within a few hours.

## Why AAO Matters Now

AI agents are not just answering questions. They are completing tasks. OpenAI's Operator browses the web and completes tasks. Google's Gemini agents handle multi-step workflows. Apple Intelligence manages scheduling and communications. Anthropic's Claude can use computers, fill out forms, and navigate websites. These shipped to millions of users in 2025 and 2026.

The businesses that AI agents can actually operate on will capture a growing share of transactions. The ones they cannot operate on will be skipped in favor of competitors that are agent-ready.

This is the same pattern that played out with SEO in the 2000s. Early adopters captured disproportionate market share while competitors scrambled to catch up. AAO is following the same trajectory, but on a compressed timeline.
